name: Anime Festival Asia (Singapore)
blurb: The flagship, original Anime Festival Asia show since 2008: three nights of J-pop/anime concerts plus an exhibition hall at Suntec Singapore.

picks: Anime composer, Mobile Suit Gundam SEED

editions.evidence: Official key art (og image, AFASG26KV.webp): '27-29 NOV 2026 SUNTEC SINGAPORE CONVENTION & EXHIBITION CENTRE'; homepage text: 'Anime Festival Asia Singapore 2026 27 – 29 November 2026 Suntec City Convention & Exhibition Centre, Hall 401 – 406'.

notes: AFA Singapore's '/guests/' page mixes night-concert artistes with the separate 'AFA NEXT STAGE GUESTS' panel program; both are picked here under this one page since the site itself files them together. Most concert-artiste cards carry only a name + 'CONCERT ARTISTE' with no further bio, so Known for is left blank for those per the card-text rule; only Kajiura, Aooo, KAF, Isekaijoucho, Kyary Pamyu Pamyu, May'n and Kajiwara had enough card text for a real credit. Liella! is a vocal unit shown with three member photos captioned '[name] as [character]' (e.g. 'Naomi Payton as Sumire Heanna'), but the section labels on those three cards are visibly shifted by one card (each card's 'section' matches the PREVIOUS card's name), a clear sign the scraper's name/character text is not reliably paired to the right photo for this trio — so only the group card 'Liella!' itself is picked and the three member sub-cards are skipped rather than risk a wrong name-photo match. A segment header with no bio ('KAMITSUBAKI STAGE SEGMENT') and a group segment title ('HoneyWorks Vocal All Stars SEGMENT', itself not an individual performer — its named vocalists CHiCO, Hanon, Kotoha, Erisa Higashiyama, Hina Hinahata, Rio Nagao and Yura Nishihara are picked individually instead) were both skipped as non-guest section dividers.
